# Check A04-elm284 on a phone

1. Install the next APK; Tatakikun as the keyboard; open any text field.
2. Type `ki`: every candidate in the bar is whole; none is cut off at the right edge.
3. Tap ⌄: the list starts with the bar's candidates that did not fit (起, ki, キ…), in lines that fit the screen; nothing scrolls sideways.
4. Tap one of them: it is typed.
5. Type `nihaoshijie`: the long candidates fit or move under ⌄.
